真题 · Cambridge IELTS 21 Academic · PDF 第 95 页

The chart and table below show the results of a survey of library users at a university.

本次写作任务

写Overview、用户构成段和满意度段（约150–180词）。用表格中的真实百分数作比较；说明44%不是“本科生满意率”，并准确表达percentage points。

0 词

对照答案，回到证据

参考写法

下列段落为针对原题编写的参考写法，用于对照内容和表达；写作没有唯一标准答案。

Overall, full-time undergraduates formed the largest group of library users, while academic staff accounted for the smallest share. Satisfaction was particularly strong for staff helpfulness and opening hours, whereas journals and wi-fi attracted the highest proportions of dissatisfied responses.

Full-time undergraduates represented 44% of users, followed by full-time postgraduates at 25%. Part-time postgraduates made up a further 16%, meaning that postgraduate students together accounted for 41%, slightly less than the undergraduate group. Distance learners and academic staff comprised the remaining 8% and 7% respectively.

Turning to the services, 95% of users were very satisfied with staff helpfulness, compared with 65% for opening hours, a difference of 30 percentage points. Neither item received any dissatisfied responses. The shares who were very satisfied with books, journals and wi-fi were considerably lower, at 50%, 45% and 48%. Dissatisfaction with journals was highest at 20%, closely followed by wi-fi at 19%, while the figure for books was 10%.

饼图分母为所有library users；表格每行是该服务的满意度分布。44%本科用户不能说成44%本科生满意。

95%与65%的差是30个百分点，不是“30%增长”；本题没有年份变化。

研究生两组25%+16%=41%，与本科44%可作合并比较；原图各类总计100%。

答后精读

篇章结构

概述分别覆盖用户构成、服务评价。

一段只处理饼图，合理合并两类研究生。

一段处理表格，先最佳两项，再比较较弱三项。

词语与搭配

accounted for / represented / made up：静态占比动词。

a difference of 30 percentage points：两个百分数相减。

closely followed by：指出19%与20%接近。

句子精读

Neither item received any dissatisfied responses. → neither覆盖刚提到的staff helpfulness和opening hours。

meaning that postgraduate students together accounted for 41% → 合并的是同一总体下的两个互斥类别。

官方样题 · IELTS Academic Writing Sample Tasks (2023) · PDF 第 3 页

The chart below shows the number of men and women in further education in Britain in three periods and whether they were studying full-time or part-time.

本次写作任务

写Overview及两个主体段（约150–180词）：按part-time/full-time分组，跨性别和年份作比较。纵轴是thousands，图上非刻度交点的数使用about。

0 词

对照答案，回到证据

参考写法

下列段落为针对原题编写的参考写法，用于对照内容和表达；写作没有唯一标准答案。

Overall, part-time study was much more common than full-time study among both men and women in all three periods. Female participation increased in both modes, and by 1990/91 women outnumbered men in part-time education, while the numbers studying full-time were similar.

About one million men studied part-time in 1970/71, compared with roughly 750,000 women. Male participation then declined to around 850,000 in 1980/81 before recovering to about 900,000 in 1990/91. The corresponding female figure rose steadily, reaching just over 800,000 in the middle period and approximately 1.1 million in the final one. Thus, the initial male lead was reversed by the end.

Full-time numbers were considerably smaller. Around 100,000 men followed full-time courses in 1970/71, compared with fewer than 100,000 women. Both figures subsequently increased. Female full-time participation had moved above the male figure by 1980/81, and by 1990/91 the totals for the two sexes were both in the region of a quarter of a million.

纵轴thousands：1000相当于1,000,000人；不能把灰柱1000写成1000人或1000%。

灰柱part-time始终远高于黑柱full-time。男性part-time先降后回升，不能写三期持续上升。

女性part-time最终约1.1 million高于男性约0.9 million；采用图形估读的约数，不把粗图假装精确调查数据。

答后精读

篇章结构

Overview横跨两个性别和两种形式。

主体一用part-time的起点差距、转折、终点反转构成比较链。

主体二把较小的full-time群体集中处理。

词语与搭配

outnumbered men：人数超过男性，而非增长率超过男性。

the corresponding female figure：省去重复part-time participation。

in the region of a quarter of a million：粗图估读的稳妥表达。

句子精读

Male participation then declined ... before recovering ... → before后动名词标示先降后升。

Thus, the initial male lead was reversed by the end. → 总结比较，不添加原因。

官方样题 · IELTS Academic Writing Sample Tasks (2023) · PDF 第 4 页

The graph below shows radio and television audiences throughout the day in 1992.

本次写作任务

保留图中一天的完整时间轴，写Overview及两个主体段（约150–180词）。须写清百分比人群、广播早高峰与电视晚高峰；不能把一天内的时段变化写成年增长。

0 词

对照答案，回到证据

参考写法

下列段落为针对原题编写的参考写法，用于对照内容和表达；写作没有唯一标准答案。

Overall, radio attracted its largest audience in the morning, while television viewing was concentrated in the evening. Television reached a substantially higher peak than radio, and both media had very small audiences during the early hours of the morning.

At 6 a.m., approximately 5% of the UK population aged over four listened to the radio, while virtually nobody was watching television. Radio listening rose rapidly to a peak of about 27% at around 8 a.m. It then generally declined through the day, despite a modest recovery in the late afternoon. By late evening, the figure had fallen to well below 10%, and it approached zero during the night.

Television viewing remained below 10% throughout the morning before rising around lunchtime and overtaking radio early in the afternoon. After a brief period near 15%, the television audience increased sharply in the late afternoon and evening, peaking at roughly 45–47% around 8 p.m. It subsequently dropped steeply, especially after midnight, and was only a few per cent by the following morning.

对象是UK population over 4 years old；百分比不能写成millions。图题范围October–December 1992，横轴6am到次日6am。

广播峰值约27%，电视约45–47%；粗线图允许about，不需要虚构47.3%。

“overtaking radio early in the afternoon”来自两线相交；不能把晚间电视优势扩成全天每时段都更高。

答后精读

篇章结构

Overview先比峰值出现时段，再比峰值大小。

广播段按主要升降，不追逐每个小波动。

电视段突出午后反超、晚间最高、午夜后下降。

词语与搭配

was concentrated in the evening：集中发生的时间。

despite a modest recovery：概括主趋势中的小反向变化。

virtually nobody：接近零，不强行写0.0%。

句子精读

It then generally declined ... despite a modest recovery ... → generally给真实波动留空间。

After a brief period near 15%, ... → 介词短语给出第二次明显上涨前的平台。

官方样题 · IELTS Academic Writing Sample Tasks (2023) · PDF 第 5 页

The diagram below shows the process by which bricks are manufactured for the building industry.

本次写作任务

写Overview及两个主体段（约150–180词）。保留wire cutter / mould的二选一分支、24–48小时干燥、两档窑温和48–72小时冷却；按工序分段。

0 词

对照答案，回到证据

参考写法

下列段落为针对原题编写的参考写法，用于对照内容和表达；写作没有唯一标准答案。

Overall, brick manufacture begins with the excavation of clay and ends with the packaging and delivery of the finished product. The material passes through preparation, shaping, drying, heating and cooling, with two alternative methods available for forming individual bricks.

First, clay is dug from the ground by a mechanical digger and placed on a metal grid above a roller. The material is broken into smaller pieces before sand and water are added. The resulting mixture is then shaped into bricks either by a wire cutter or by being placed in moulds. These are alternative routes at the same stage, rather than consecutive operations that every brick must undergo.

The newly formed bricks are dried in an oven for 24 to 48 hours. They are then heated in a kiln, initially at a moderate temperature of 200–980°C and subsequently at a higher temperature of 870–1300°C. After this, they spend 48 to 72 hours in a cooling chamber. Finally, the cooled bricks are packaged and loaded for delivery by truck.

原图or连接wire cutter和mould，参考写法用either ... or，不能写先切后入模。

干燥24–48h与冷却48–72h不同；窑炉先200–980°C、后870–1300°C，区间重叠是原图数据，不自行“纠正”。

被动语态描述材料经历：is dug / are added / are dried；无需凭空添加工人或工厂地点。

答后精读

篇章结构

Overview起终点加主要加工阶段。

前段写原料准备与成形分支。

后段写热处理、冷却和配送。

词语与搭配

either by a wire cutter or by being placed in moulds：两种方式保持平行。

initially ... subsequently：区分两档窑温。

the resulting mixture：回指已经加入沙和水的黏土。

句子精读

The material is broken into smaller pieces before sand and water are added. → 两个被动结构保留明确先后。

They are then heated ... initially ... and subsequently ... → 同一heated谓语承接两个温度阶段。

官方样题 · IELTS Academic Writing — modified large print · PDF 第 4 页

The table below gives information about the percentage of the population by age group in one town who rode a bicycle in June 2011.

本次写作任务

写Overview及两个比较段（约150–180词），先比较儿童/青少年，再比较成人；指出最低组和60+回升。列出最大性别差距并用percentage points表达。

0 词

对照答案，回到证据

参考写法

下列段落为针对原题编写的参考写法，用于对照内容和表达；写作没有唯一标准答案。

Overall, cycling was most common among children under ten and least common in the 40–59 age group. Males had higher participation rates than females in every category, although the difference between the sexes was very small among the youngest children.

Among those aged 0–9, 51.3% of males and 50.3% of females rode a bicycle, a gap of just one percentage point. Participation was lower among 10–17-year-olds, at 42.2% for males and 24.6% for females. This group therefore had the largest gender difference, amounting to 17.6 percentage points, with the male figure considerably higher than the female one.

The proportions were smaller in both adult groups below sixty. For people aged 18–39, the rates were 17.1% and 9.7% respectively, falling to 12.3% and 8.0% among 40–59-year-olds. However, the figures rose again in the oldest category: 18.5% of men and 13.2% of women aged sixty or above cycled. Thus, participation did not simply decrease continuously across the age groups.

这是June 2011单月横截面：年龄组之间差异不证明同一批人随时间减少骑行。

10–17岁差距42.2−24.6=17.6个百分点；0–9岁差距1.0个百分点。

两性最低都是40–59岁，60+均回升；不能写年龄越大比例总是越低。

答后精读

篇章结构

Overview同时覆盖年龄高低与性别关系。

前段突出高参与儿童及最大差距青少年。

后段写成人低谷与60+例外。

词语与搭配

a gap of just one percentage point：不是one per cent decrease。

amounting to 17.6 percentage points：补充精确差值。

across the age groups：年龄间比较，避免错误时间趋势。

句子精读

For people aged 18–39, the rates were 17.1% and 9.7% respectively ... → 顺序沿用前段male/female。

However, the figures rose again in the oldest category ... → rose描述相邻年龄组数值变化，最后一句明确并非持续时间变化。

The café now has a wider range of dedicated food and drink outlets. The kitchen, toilets and central indoor seating area have been retained, while outdoor seating and a barbecue have been added.

text: 看图写作 · 段落练习 用真实题目练习多段写作。先审题并写出自己的段落，再看针对原题的参考写法和修改依据。 共 8 组，来自 8 道不同原题；同源练习已标注。 查找 进度 全部 未作答 已作答 继续未做的一组 全部 折线图 · 2 地图 · 1 自然流程图 · 1 饼图与表格 · 1 柱状图 · 1 制作流程图 · 1 表格 · 1 没有符合条件的练习，试试更换关键词或进度。 美国四行业就业：峰值、交叉与最终排名 未作答 折线图 · 原题拆段写作 · 参考段落与逐段讲解 真题 · Cambridge IELTS 21 Academic · PDF 第 30 页 The graph below gives information about the number of jobs in four sectors of the economy in the US between 1960 and 2020. 点击图示可查看大图。 本次写作任务 先独立写Overview，再写两个主体段（共约150–180词）：一段写制造业与农业，另一段写零售与医疗。必须给出单位，并交代制造业中途的峰值；不逐点流水账。 我的段落 0 词 保留作答，打开答案与精读 对照答案，回到证据 参考写法 下列段落为针对原题编写的参考写法，用于对照内容和表达；写作没有唯一标准答案。 Overall, manufacturing provided the most jobs at the beginning of the period, but it was overtaken by both retail and healthcare by 2020. Healthcare experienced the strongest growth, whereas agricultural employment declined and remained the smallest of the four sectors at the end. Manufacturing employment rose from 15 million in 1960 to a peak of 20 million in 1980. It then fell to approximately 17 million in 2000 and 13 million in 2020. Agriculture followed a different pattern: its workforce dropped from about 6 million to 3 million during the first twenty years, remained at that level in 2000, and decreased to roughly 2 million by the end. By contrast, the number of retail jobs increased throughout, from around 6 million in 1960 to 10 million in 1980 and 15 million in 2000, before reaching about 16 million in 2020. Healthcare grew from only 2 million jobs to 5 million and then 11 million, eventually matching retail at approximately 16 million. 原图纵轴是Jobs in millions：15表示1500万个岗位，不是15%或15万人。 制造业1980年达到20 million，之后下降；不能概括为1960–2020持续下降。 零售与医疗2020年约16 million并列；医疗从2到16增长约14 million，增幅最大。农业1980与2000均约3 million，不能写每阶段都下降。 答后精读 篇章结构 Overview回答主导行业更替与两组趋势。 主体一合并峰值后下降的制造业和总体下降的农业。 主体二并写增长行业，用最终并列收束比较。 词语与搭配 rise to a peak of 20 million：峰值位置与单位同时保留。 be overtaken by：排名改变；这里由2020年的终点比较支持。 eventually matching retail：结果分词短语，不再重复整句。 句子精读 Manufacturing employment rose from 15 million in 1960 to a peak of 20 million in 1980. → from交代起点，to交代终点；of连接峰值大小。 Healthcare grew ... eventually matching retail ... → matching的主语仍是Healthcare，不是2020。 我的修订／证据笔记 学院咖啡厅改造：保留设施与功能替换 未作答 地图 · 原题拆段写作 · 参考段落与逐段讲解 真题 · Cambridge IELTS 21 Academic · PDF 第 52 页 The plans below show a college café before it was redesigned and how it looks now. 点击图示可查看大图。 本次写作任务 对照前后两张原图，写Overview和两个主体段（约150–180词）：第一段写室内功能替换，第二段写保留设施与室外扩展。原图没有指北针，用left/right/top/bottom或相对设施定位。 我的段落 0 词 保留作答，打开答案与精读 对照答案，回到证据 参考写法 下列段落为针对原题编写的参考写法，用于对照内容和表达；写作没有唯一标准答案。 Overall, the café has been redesigned to offer a wider range of food and drink services, and an outdoor seating area has been added. The kitchen and toilets remain in their original positions, while the former staff dining rooms now serve different purposes. Previously, all food and drink were available from a single serving area directly below the kitchen. This counter is now used for hot meals, and a salad bar has been installed along the left-hand wall of the main seating area. The two staff dining rooms along the upper edge of the main seating area have been converted into a takeaway food outlet and a coffee bar respectively. Tables and chairs still occupy the main central area. At the bottom of the present plan, an outdoor seating area extends beyond the former café boundary, with a barbecue at its left end. New doorways connect this area to the interior. Near the entrance on the right-hand side, recycling bins have replaced the original bin, while the toilets remain in the lower-right corner. 不是“图书馆改造”：真实材料是college café。两间staff dining rooms分别变为take away food和coffee bar，必须对应两处功能。 厨房与厕所位置保留；增设沙拉吧、室外座位、barbecue，bin改为recycling bins。 原图对比过去与现在，故用previously + past、now + present以及has been added；没有未来规划，不能用will be built。 答后精读 篇章结构 概述先概括服务多样化和室外扩展，再点出保留。 室内按厨房—服务区—原职工餐厅的邻接关系走图。 室外扩展与入口附近小变化同段收尾。 词语与搭配 have been converted into：旧功能转为新功能。 remain in their original positions：明确保留而不是遗漏。 beyond the former café boundary：说明扩展到原边界之外。 句子精读 The two staff dining rooms ... have been converted into a takeaway food outlet and a coffee bar respectively. → respectively按列举顺序配对，不能互换位置。 with a barbecue at its left end → its指outdoor seating area；没有虚构东南西北。 我的修订／证据笔记 雨影沙漠：越山前后的水分变化 未作答 自然流程图 · 原题拆段写作 · 参考段落与逐段讲解 真题 · Cambridge IELTS 21 Academic · PDF 第 73 页 The diagram below shows how one type of desert, known as a rain-shadow desert, is formed. 点击图示可查看大图。 本次写作任务 写Overview与两个主体段（约150–180词），沿原图7个编号描述迎风坡降雨及背风坡干燥；只使用图中可见机制，不添加温度数值或当地名称。 我的段落 0 词 保留作答，打开答案与精读 对照答案，回到证据 参考写法 下列段落为针对原题编写的参考写法，用于对照内容和表达；写作没有唯一标准答案。 Overall, rain-shadow deserts form inland after winds have crossed a mountain range. The key contrast is between the windward side, where rising moist air produces clouds and rain, and the leeward side, where the air continues towards the interior in a dry state. The process begins when winds approach the coast from the sea. On reaching the mountains, they are pushed upwards along the windward slope. As the moist air rises, it cools, and clouds form above this side of the mountains. Rain then falls, removing moisture from the air before it passes over the mountain range. These are successive stages rather than two separate routes through the diagram. The remaining dry air continues over the summit and moves down the leeward side. Dry winds subsequently reach areas further inland, where a rain-shadow desert is found. The diagram indicates that the distance from the coast towards this inland area can extend over thousands of kilometres, emphasising that the final dry region lies beyond the mountain barrier. 原图7步：海风到岸→被迫抬升→湿空气升高冷却→云形成→下雨→干空气越山→干风抵达内陆。 用windward与leeward形成机制对比，而不是编造沙漠经历采矿或开垦。 图上仅标thousands of kilometres，不能改为准确3000公里；这是空间尺度，不是形成所需时间。 答后精读 篇章结构 Overview交代终点与关键转变：湿气在越山前被降雨带走。 主体一描述迎风坡上的连续阶段。 主体二描述背风坡及最终形成的内陆干燥区。 词语与搭配 on reaching the mountains：on + 动名词表示“一到达”。 as the moist air rises：as联系同步发生的上升与冷却。 in a dry state：准确描述性质变化而非另加数字。 句子精读 As the moist air rises, it cools, and clouds form ... → 一个时间/伴随从句连接三个连续变化。 where a rain-shadow desert is found → where修饰areas further inland，不指海岸。 我的修订／证据笔记 图书馆用户与满意度：两图的不同分母 未作答 饼图与表格 · 原题拆段写作 · 参考段落与逐段讲解 真题 · Cambridge IELTS 21 Academic · PDF 第 95 页 The chart and table below show the results of a survey of library users at a university. 点击图示可查看大图。 本次写作任务 写Overview、用户构成段和满意度段（约150–180词）。用表格中的真实百分数作比较；说明44%不是“本科生满意率”，并准确表达percentage points。 我的段落 0 词 保留作答，打开答案与精读 对照答案，回到证据 参考写法 下列段落为针对原题编写的参考写法，用于对照内容和表达；写作没有唯一标准答案。 Overall, full-time undergraduates formed the largest group of library users, while academic staff accounted for the smallest share. Satisfaction was particularly strong for staff helpfulness and opening hours, whereas journals and wi-fi attracted the highest proportions of dissatisfied responses. Full-time undergraduates represented 44% of users, followed by full-time postgraduates at 25%. Part-time postgraduates made up a further 16%, meaning that postgraduate students together accounted for 41%, slightly less than the undergraduate group. Distance learners and academic staff comprised the remaining 8% and 7% respectively. Turning to the services, 95% of users were very satisfied with staff helpfulness, compared with 65% for opening hours, a difference of 30 percentage points. Neither item received any dissatisfied responses. The shares who were very satisfied with books, journals and wi-fi were considerably lower, at 50%, 45% and 48%. Dissatisfaction with journals was highest at 20%, closely followed by wi-fi at 19%, while the figure for books was 10%. 饼图分母为所有library users；表格每行是该服务的满意度分布。44%本科用户不能说成44%本科生满意。 95%与65%的差是30个百分点，不是“30%增长”；本题没有年份变化。 研究生两组25%+16%=41%，与本科44%可作合并比较；原图各类总计100%。 答后精读 篇章结构 概述分别覆盖用户构成、服务评价。 一段只处理饼图，合理合并两类研究生。 一段处理表格，先最佳两项，再比较较弱三项。 词语与搭配 accounted for / represented / made up：静态占比动词。 a difference of 30 percentage points：两个百分数相减。 closely followed by：指出19%与20%接近。 句子精读 Neither item received any dissatisfied responses. → neither覆盖刚提到的staff helpfulness和opening hours。 meaning that postgraduate students together accounted for 41% → 合并的是同一总体下的两个互斥类别。 我的修订／证据笔记 英国继续教育：人数与学习形式 未作答 柱状图 · 原题拆段写作 · 参考段落与逐段讲解 官方样题 · IELTS Academic Writing Sample Tasks (2023) · PDF 第 3 页 The chart below shows the number of men and women in further education in Britain in three periods and whether they were studying full-time or part-time. 点击图示可查看大图。 本次写作任务 写Overview及两个主体段（约150–180词）：按part-time/full-time分组，跨性别和年份作比较。纵轴是thousands，图上非刻度交点的数使用about。 我的段落 0 词 保留作答，打开答案与精读 对照答案，回到证据 参考写法 下列段落为针对原题编写的参考写法，用于对照内容和表达；写作没有唯一标准答案。 Overall, part-time study was much more common than full-time study among both men and women in all three periods. Female participation increased in both modes, and by 1990/91 women outnumbered men in part-time education, while the numbers studying full-time were similar. About one million men studied part-time in 1970/71, compared with roughly 750,000 women. Male participation then declined to around 850,000 in 1980/81 before recovering to about 900,000 in 1990/91. The corresponding female figure rose steadily, reaching just over 800,000 in the middle period and approximately 1.1 million in the final one. Thus, the initial male lead was reversed by the end. Full-time numbers were considerably smaller. Around 100,000 men followed full-time courses in 1970/71, compared with fewer than 100,000 women. Both figures subsequently increased. Female full-time participation had moved above the male figure by 1980/81, and by 1990/91 the totals for the two sexes were both in the region of a quarter of a million. 纵轴thousands：1000相当于1,000,000人；不能把灰柱1000写成1000人或1000%。 灰柱part-time始终远高于黑柱full-time。男性part-time先降后回升，不能写三期持续上升。 女性part-time最终约1.1 million高于男性约0.9 million；采用图形估读的约数，不把粗图假装精确调查数据。 答后精读 篇章结构 Overview横跨两个性别和两种形式。 主体一用part-time的起点差距、转折、终点反转构成比较链。 主体二把较小的full-time群体集中处理。 词语与搭配 outnumbered men：人数超过男性，而非增长率超过男性。 the corresponding female figure：省去重复part-time participation。 in the region of a quarter of a million：粗图估读的稳妥表达。 句子精读 Male participation then declined ... before recovering ... → before后动名词标示先降后升。 Thus, the initial male lead was reversed by the end. → 总结比较，不添加原因。 我的修订／证据笔记 广播与电视受众：同一天的双峰比较 未作答 折线图 · 原题拆段写作 · 参考段落与逐段讲解 官方样题 · IELTS Academic Writing Sample Tasks (2023) · PDF 第 4 页 The graph below shows radio and television audiences throughout the day in 1992. 点击图示可查看大图。 本次写作任务 保留图中一天的完整时间轴，写Overview及两个主体段（约150–180词）。须写清百分比人群、广播早高峰与电视晚高峰；不能把一天内的时段变化写成年增长。 我的段落 0 词 保留作答，打开答案与精读 对照答案，回到证据 参考写法 下列段落为针对原题编写的参考写法，用于对照内容和表达；写作没有唯一标准答案。 Overall, radio attracted its largest audience in the morning, while television viewing was concentrated in the evening. Television reached a substantially higher peak than radio, and both media had very small audiences during the early hours of the morning. At 6 a.m., approximately 5% of the UK population aged over four listened to the radio, while virtually nobody was watching television. Radio listening rose rapidly to a peak of about 27% at around 8 a.m. It then generally declined through the day, despite a modest recovery in the late afternoon. By late evening, the figure had fallen to well below 10%, and it approached zero during the night. Television viewing remained below 10% throughout the morning before rising around lunchtime and overtaking radio early in the afternoon. After a brief period near 15%, the television audience increased sharply in the late afternoon and evening, peaking at roughly 45–47% around 8 p.m. It subsequently dropped steeply, especially after midnight, and was only a few per cent by the following morning. 对象是UK population over 4 years old；百分比不能写成millions。图题范围October–December 1992，横轴6am到次日6am。 广播峰值约27%，电视约45–47%；粗线图允许about，不需要虚构47.3%。 “overtaking radio early in the afternoon”来自两线相交；不能把晚间电视优势扩成全天每时段都更高。 答后精读 篇章结构 Overview先比峰值出现时段，再比峰值大小。 广播段按主要升降，不追逐每个小波动。 电视段突出午后反超、晚间最高、午夜后下降。 词语与搭配 was concentrated in the evening：集中发生的时间。 despite a modest recovery：概括主趋势中的小反向变化。 virtually nobody：接近零，不强行写0.0%。 句子精读 It then generally declined ... despite a modest recovery ... → generally给真实波动留空间。 After a brief period near 15%, ... → 介词短语给出第二次明显上涨前的平台。 我的修订／证据笔记 制砖：并行成形路径与温度阶段 未作答 制作流程图 · 原题拆段写作 · 参考段落与逐段讲解 官方样题 · IELTS Academic Writing Sample Tasks (2023) · PDF 第 5 页 The diagram below shows the process by which bricks are manufactured for the building industry. 点击图示可查看大图。 本次写作任务 写Overview及两个主体段（约150–180词）。保留wire cutter / mould的二选一分支、24–48小时干燥、两档窑温和48–72小时冷却；按工序分段。 我的段落 0 词 保留作答，打开答案与精读 对照答案，回到证据 参考写法 下列段落为针对原题编写的参考写法，用于对照内容和表达；写作没有唯一标准答案。 Overall, brick manufacture begins with the excavation of clay and ends with the packaging and delivery of the finished product. The material passes through preparation, shaping, drying, heating and cooling, with two alternative methods available for forming individual bricks. First, clay is dug from the ground by a mechanical digger and placed on a metal grid above a roller. The material is broken into smaller pieces before sand and water are added. The resulting mixture is then shaped into bricks either by a wire cutter or by being placed in moulds. These are alternative routes at the same stage, rather than consecutive operations that every brick must undergo. The newly formed bricks are dried in an oven for 24 to 48 hours. They are then heated in a kiln, initially at a moderate temperature of 200–980°C and subsequently at a higher temperature of 870–1300°C. After this, they spend 48 to 72 hours in a cooling chamber. Finally, the cooled bricks are packaged and loaded for delivery by truck. 原图or连接wire cutter和mould，参考写法用either ... or，不能写先切后入模。 干燥24–48h与冷却48–72h不同；窑炉先200–980°C、后870–1300°C，区间重叠是原图数据，不自行“纠正”。 被动语态描述材料经历：is dug / are added / are dried；无需凭空添加工人或工厂地点。 答后精读 篇章结构 Overview起终点加主要加工阶段。 前段写原料准备与成形分支。 后段写热处理、冷却和配送。 词语与搭配 either by a wire cutter or by being placed in moulds：两种方式保持平行。 initially ... subsequently：区分两档窑温。 the resulting mixture：回指已经加入沙和水的黏土。 句子精读 The material is broken into smaller pieces before sand and water are added. → 两个被动结构保留明确先后。 They are then heated ... initially ... and subsequently ... → 同一heated谓语承接两个温度阶段。 我的修订／证据笔记 同题官方考生样本 · Band 8.5 · 1C Script C 优先对照这份同题官方考生稿及考官评语；分数仅属于该原稿。本地参考段落仍为原创教学示范。 官方作答 · 第16页 考官评语 · 第17页 官方在线原件 先看原样本怎样概括关键阶段，再对照本地短段的分支、时长和温度；8.5仍有概述可改进处。 自行车使用率：年龄比较与百分点差 未作答 表格 · 原题拆段写作 · 参考段落与逐段讲解 官方样题 · IELTS Academic Writing — modified large print · PDF 第 4 页 The table below gives information about the percentage of the population by age group in one town who rode a bicycle in June 2011. 点击图示可查看大图。 本次写作任务 写Overview及两个比较段（约150–180词），先比较儿童/青少年，再比较成人；指出最低组和60+回升。列出最大性别差距并用percentage points表达。 我的段落 0 词 保留作答，打开答案与精读 对照答案，回到证据 参考写法 下列段落为针对原题编写的参考写法，用于对照内容和表达；写作没有唯一标准答案。 Overall, cycling was most common among children under ten and least common in the 40–59 age group. Males had higher participation rates than females in every category, although the difference between the sexes was very small among the youngest children. Among those aged 0–9, 51.3% of males and 50.3% of females rode a bicycle, a gap of just one percentage point. Participation was lower among 10–17-year-olds, at 42.2% for males and 24.6% for females. This group therefore had the largest gender difference, amounting to 17.6 percentage points, with the male figure considerably higher than the female one. The proportions were smaller in both adult groups below sixty. For people aged 18–39, the rates were 17.1% and 9.7% respectively, falling to 12.3% and 8.0% among 40–59-year-olds. However, the figures rose again in the oldest category: 18.5% of men and 13.2% of women aged sixty or above cycled. Thus, participation did not simply decrease continuously across the age groups. 这是June 2011单月横截面：年龄组之间差异不证明同一批人随时间减少骑行。 10–17岁差距42.2−24.6=17.6个百分点；0–9岁差距1.0个百分点。 两性最低都是40–59岁，60+均回升；不能写年龄越大比例总是越低。 答后精读 篇章结构 Overview同时覆盖年龄高低与性别关系。 前段突出高参与儿童及最大差距青少年。 后段写成人低谷与60+例外。 词语与搭配 a gap of just one percentage point：不是one per cent decrease。 amounting to 17.6 percentage points：补充精确差值。 across the age groups：年龄间比较，避免错误时间趋势。 句子精读 For people aged 18–39, the rates were 17.1% and 9.7% respectively ... → 顺序沿用前段male/female。 However, the figures rose again in the oldest category ... → rose描述相邻年龄组数值变化，最后一句明确并非持续时间变化。 我的修订／证据笔记

看图写作 · 段落练习

用真实题目练习多段写作。先审题并写出自己的段落，再看针对原题的参考写法和修改依据。 共 8 组，来自 8 道不同原题；同源练习已标注。

没有符合条件的练习，试试更换关键词或进度。

美国四行业就业：峰值、交叉与最终排名未作答折线图 · 原题拆段写作 · 参考段落与逐段讲解

真题 · Cambridge IELTS 21 Academic · PDF 第 30 页

The graph below gives information about the number of jobs in four sectors of the economy in the US between 1960 and 2020.

本次写作任务

先独立写Overview，再写两个主体段（共约150–180词）：一段写制造业与农业，另一段写零售与医疗。必须给出单位，并交代制造业中途的峰值；不逐点流水账。

0 词

对照答案，回到证据

参考写法

下列段落为针对原题编写的参考写法，用于对照内容和表达；写作没有唯一标准答案。

Overall, manufacturing provided the most jobs at the beginning of the period, but it was overtaken by both retail and healthcare by 2020. Healthcare experienced the strongest growth, whereas agricultural employment declined and remained the smallest of the four sectors at the end.

Manufacturing employment rose from 15 million in 1960 to a peak of 20 million in 1980. It then fell to approximately 17 million in 2000 and 13 million in 2020. Agriculture followed a different pattern: its workforce dropped from about 6 million to 3 million during the first twenty years, remained at that level in 2000, and decreased to roughly 2 million by the end.

By contrast, the number of retail jobs increased throughout, from around 6 million in 1960 to 10 million in 1980 and 15 million in 2000, before reaching about 16 million in 2020. Healthcare grew from only 2 million jobs to 5 million and then 11 million, eventually matching retail at approximately 16 million.

原图纵轴是Jobs in millions：15表示1500万个岗位，不是15%或15万人。

制造业1980年达到20 million，之后下降；不能概括为1960–2020持续下降。

零售与医疗2020年约16 million并列；医疗从2到16增长约14 million，增幅最大。农业1980与2000均约3 million，不能写每阶段都下降。

答后精读

篇章结构

Overview回答主导行业更替与两组趋势。

主体一合并峰值后下降的制造业和总体下降的农业。

主体二并写增长行业，用最终并列收束比较。

词语与搭配

rise to a peak of 20 million：峰值位置与单位同时保留。

be overtaken by：排名改变；这里由2020年的终点比较支持。

eventually matching retail：结果分词短语，不再重复整句。

句子精读

Manufacturing employment rose from 15 million in 1960 to a peak of 20 million in 1980. → from交代起点，to交代终点；of连接峰值大小。

Healthcare grew ... eventually matching retail ... → matching的主语仍是Healthcare，不是2020。

学院咖啡厅改造：保留设施与功能替换未作答地图 · 原题拆段写作 · 参考段落与逐段讲解

真题 · Cambridge IELTS 21 Academic · PDF 第 52 页

The plans below show a college café before it was redesigned and how it looks now.

本次写作任务

对照前后两张原图，写Overview和两个主体段（约150–180词）：第一段写室内功能替换，第二段写保留设施与室外扩展。原图没有指北针，用left/right/top/bottom或相对设施定位。

0 词

对照答案，回到证据

参考写法

下列段落为针对原题编写的参考写法，用于对照内容和表达；写作没有唯一标准答案。

Overall, the café has been redesigned to offer a wider range of food and drink services, and an outdoor seating area has been added. The kitchen and toilets remain in their original positions, while the former staff dining rooms now serve different purposes.

Previously, all food and drink were available from a single serving area directly below the kitchen. This counter is now used for hot meals, and a salad bar has been installed along the left-hand wall of the main seating area. The two staff dining rooms along the upper edge of the main seating area have been converted into a takeaway food outlet and a coffee bar respectively. Tables and chairs still occupy the main central area.

At the bottom of the present plan, an outdoor seating area extends beyond the former café boundary, with a barbecue at its left end. New doorways connect this area to the interior. Near the entrance on the right-hand side, recycling bins have replaced the original bin, while the toilets remain in the lower-right corner.

不是“图书馆改造”：真实材料是college café。两间staff dining rooms分别变为take away food和coffee bar，必须对应两处功能。

厨房与厕所位置保留；增设沙拉吧、室外座位、barbecue，bin改为recycling bins。

原图对比过去与现在，故用previously + past、now + present以及has been added；没有未来规划，不能用will be built。

答后精读

篇章结构

概述先概括服务多样化和室外扩展，再点出保留。

室内按厨房—服务区—原职工餐厅的邻接关系走图。

室外扩展与入口附近小变化同段收尾。

词语与搭配

have been converted into：旧功能转为新功能。

remain in their original positions：明确保留而不是遗漏。

beyond the former café boundary：说明扩展到原边界之外。

句子精读

The two staff dining rooms ... have been converted into a takeaway food outlet and a coffee bar respectively. → respectively按列举顺序配对，不能互换位置。

with a barbecue at its left end → its指outdoor seating area；没有虚构东南西北。

雨影沙漠：越山前后的水分变化未作答自然流程图 · 原题拆段写作 · 参考段落与逐段讲解

真题 · Cambridge IELTS 21 Academic · PDF 第 73 页

The diagram below shows how one type of desert, known as a rain-shadow desert, is formed.

本次写作任务

写Overview与两个主体段（约150–180词），沿原图7个编号描述迎风坡降雨及背风坡干燥；只使用图中可见机制，不添加温度数值或当地名称。

0 词

对照答案，回到证据

参考写法

下列段落为针对原题编写的参考写法，用于对照内容和表达；写作没有唯一标准答案。

Overall, rain-shadow deserts form inland after winds have crossed a mountain range. The key contrast is between the windward side, where rising moist air produces clouds and rain, and the leeward side, where the air continues towards the interior in a dry state.

The process begins when winds approach the coast from the sea. On reaching the mountains, they are pushed upwards along the windward slope. As the moist air rises, it cools, and clouds form above this side of the mountains. Rain then falls, removing moisture from the air before it passes over the mountain range. These are successive stages rather than two separate routes through the diagram.

The remaining dry air continues over the summit and moves down the leeward side. Dry winds subsequently reach areas further inland, where a rain-shadow desert is found. The diagram indicates that the distance from the coast towards this inland area can extend over thousands of kilometres, emphasising that the final dry region lies beyond the mountain barrier.

原图7步：海风到岸→被迫抬升→湿空气升高冷却→云形成→下雨→干空气越山→干风抵达内陆。

用windward与leeward形成机制对比，而不是编造沙漠经历采矿或开垦。

图上仅标thousands of kilometres，不能改为准确3000公里；这是空间尺度，不是形成所需时间。

答后精读

篇章结构

Overview交代终点与关键转变：湿气在越山前被降雨带走。

主体一描述迎风坡上的连续阶段。

主体二描述背风坡及最终形成的内陆干燥区。

词语与搭配

on reaching the mountains：on + 动名词表示“一到达”。

as the moist air rises：as联系同步发生的上升与冷却。

in a dry state：准确描述性质变化而非另加数字。

句子精读

As the moist air rises, it cools, and clouds form ... → 一个时间/伴随从句连接三个连续变化。

where a rain-shadow desert is found → where修饰areas further inland，不指海岸。

图书馆用户与满意度：两图的不同分母未作答饼图与表格 · 原题拆段写作 · 参考段落与逐段讲解

真题 · Cambridge IELTS 21 Academic · PDF 第 95 页

The chart and table below show the results of a survey of library users at a university.

本次写作任务

写Overview、用户构成段和满意度段（约150–180词）。用表格中的真实百分数作比较；说明44%不是“本科生满意率”，并准确表达percentage points。

0 词

对照答案，回到证据

参考写法

下列段落为针对原题编写的参考写法，用于对照内容和表达；写作没有唯一标准答案。

Overall, full-time undergraduates formed the largest group of library users, while academic staff accounted for the smallest share. Satisfaction was particularly strong for staff helpfulness and opening hours, whereas journals and wi-fi attracted the highest proportions of dissatisfied responses.

Full-time undergraduates represented 44% of users, followed by full-time postgraduates at 25%. Part-time postgraduates made up a further 16%, meaning that postgraduate students together accounted for 41%, slightly less than the undergraduate group. Distance learners and academic staff comprised the remaining 8% and 7% respectively.

Turning to the services, 95% of users were very satisfied with staff helpfulness, compared with 65% for opening hours, a difference of 30 percentage points. Neither item received any dissatisfied responses. The shares who were very satisfied with books, journals and wi-fi were considerably lower, at 50%, 45% and 48%. Dissatisfaction with journals was highest at 20%, closely followed by wi-fi at 19%, while the figure for books was 10%.

饼图分母为所有library users；表格每行是该服务的满意度分布。44%本科用户不能说成44%本科生满意。

95%与65%的差是30个百分点，不是“30%增长”；本题没有年份变化。

研究生两组25%+16%=41%，与本科44%可作合并比较；原图各类总计100%。

答后精读

篇章结构

概述分别覆盖用户构成、服务评价。

一段只处理饼图，合理合并两类研究生。

一段处理表格，先最佳两项，再比较较弱三项。

词语与搭配

accounted for / represented / made up：静态占比动词。

a difference of 30 percentage points：两个百分数相减。

closely followed by：指出19%与20%接近。

句子精读

Neither item received any dissatisfied responses. → neither覆盖刚提到的staff helpfulness和opening hours。

meaning that postgraduate students together accounted for 41% → 合并的是同一总体下的两个互斥类别。

英国继续教育：人数与学习形式未作答柱状图 · 原题拆段写作 · 参考段落与逐段讲解

官方样题 · IELTS Academic Writing Sample Tasks (2023) · PDF 第 3 页

The chart below shows the number of men and women in further education in Britain in three periods and whether they were studying full-time or part-time.

本次写作任务

写Overview及两个主体段（约150–180词）：按part-time/full-time分组，跨性别和年份作比较。纵轴是thousands，图上非刻度交点的数使用about。

0 词

对照答案，回到证据

参考写法

下列段落为针对原题编写的参考写法，用于对照内容和表达；写作没有唯一标准答案。

Overall, part-time study was much more common than full-time study among both men and women in all three periods. Female participation increased in both modes, and by 1990/91 women outnumbered men in part-time education, while the numbers studying full-time were similar.

About one million men studied part-time in 1970/71, compared with roughly 750,000 women. Male participation then declined to around 850,000 in 1980/81 before recovering to about 900,000 in 1990/91. The corresponding female figure rose steadily, reaching just over 800,000 in the middle period and approximately 1.1 million in the final one. Thus, the initial male lead was reversed by the end.

Full-time numbers were considerably smaller. Around 100,000 men followed full-time courses in 1970/71, compared with fewer than 100,000 women. Both figures subsequently increased. Female full-time participation had moved above the male figure by 1980/81, and by 1990/91 the totals for the two sexes were both in the region of a quarter of a million.

纵轴thousands：1000相当于1,000,000人；不能把灰柱1000写成1000人或1000%。

灰柱part-time始终远高于黑柱full-time。男性part-time先降后回升，不能写三期持续上升。

女性part-time最终约1.1 million高于男性约0.9 million；采用图形估读的约数，不把粗图假装精确调查数据。

答后精读

篇章结构

Overview横跨两个性别和两种形式。

主体一用part-time的起点差距、转折、终点反转构成比较链。

主体二把较小的full-time群体集中处理。

词语与搭配

outnumbered men：人数超过男性，而非增长率超过男性。

the corresponding female figure：省去重复part-time participation。

in the region of a quarter of a million：粗图估读的稳妥表达。

句子精读

Male participation then declined ... before recovering ... → before后动名词标示先降后升。

Thus, the initial male lead was reversed by the end. → 总结比较，不添加原因。

广播与电视受众：同一天的双峰比较未作答折线图 · 原题拆段写作 · 参考段落与逐段讲解

官方样题 · IELTS Academic Writing Sample Tasks (2023) · PDF 第 4 页

The graph below shows radio and television audiences throughout the day in 1992.

本次写作任务

保留图中一天的完整时间轴，写Overview及两个主体段（约150–180词）。须写清百分比人群、广播早高峰与电视晚高峰；不能把一天内的时段变化写成年增长。

0 词

对照答案，回到证据

参考写法

下列段落为针对原题编写的参考写法，用于对照内容和表达；写作没有唯一标准答案。

Overall, radio attracted its largest audience in the morning, while television viewing was concentrated in the evening. Television reached a substantially higher peak than radio, and both media had very small audiences during the early hours of the morning.

At 6 a.m., approximately 5% of the UK population aged over four listened to the radio, while virtually nobody was watching television. Radio listening rose rapidly to a peak of about 27% at around 8 a.m. It then generally declined through the day, despite a modest recovery in the late afternoon. By late evening, the figure had fallen to well below 10%, and it approached zero during the night.

Television viewing remained below 10% throughout the morning before rising around lunchtime and overtaking radio early in the afternoon. After a brief period near 15%, the television audience increased sharply in the late afternoon and evening, peaking at roughly 45–47% around 8 p.m. It subsequently dropped steeply, especially after midnight, and was only a few per cent by the following morning.

对象是UK population over 4 years old；百分比不能写成millions。图题范围October–December 1992，横轴6am到次日6am。

广播峰值约27%，电视约45–47%；粗线图允许about，不需要虚构47.3%。

“overtaking radio early in the afternoon”来自两线相交；不能把晚间电视优势扩成全天每时段都更高。

答后精读

篇章结构

Overview先比峰值出现时段，再比峰值大小。

广播段按主要升降，不追逐每个小波动。

电视段突出午后反超、晚间最高、午夜后下降。

词语与搭配

was concentrated in the evening：集中发生的时间。

despite a modest recovery：概括主趋势中的小反向变化。

virtually nobody：接近零，不强行写0.0%。

句子精读

It then generally declined ... despite a modest recovery ... → generally给真实波动留空间。

After a brief period near 15%, ... → 介词短语给出第二次明显上涨前的平台。

制砖：并行成形路径与温度阶段未作答制作流程图 · 原题拆段写作 · 参考段落与逐段讲解

官方样题 · IELTS Academic Writing Sample Tasks (2023) · PDF 第 5 页

The diagram below shows the process by which bricks are manufactured for the building industry.

本次写作任务

写Overview及两个主体段（约150–180词）。保留wire cutter / mould的二选一分支、24–48小时干燥、两档窑温和48–72小时冷却；按工序分段。

0 词

对照答案，回到证据

参考写法

下列段落为针对原题编写的参考写法，用于对照内容和表达；写作没有唯一标准答案。

Overall, brick manufacture begins with the excavation of clay and ends with the packaging and delivery of the finished product. The material passes through preparation, shaping, drying, heating and cooling, with two alternative methods available for forming individual bricks.

First, clay is dug from the ground by a mechanical digger and placed on a metal grid above a roller. The material is broken into smaller pieces before sand and water are added. The resulting mixture is then shaped into bricks either by a wire cutter or by being placed in moulds. These are alternative routes at the same stage, rather than consecutive operations that every brick must undergo.

The newly formed bricks are dried in an oven for 24 to 48 hours. They are then heated in a kiln, initially at a moderate temperature of 200–980°C and subsequently at a higher temperature of 870–1300°C. After this, they spend 48 to 72 hours in a cooling chamber. Finally, the cooled bricks are packaged and loaded for delivery by truck.

原图or连接wire cutter和mould，参考写法用either ... or，不能写先切后入模。

干燥24–48h与冷却48–72h不同；窑炉先200–980°C、后870–1300°C，区间重叠是原图数据，不自行“纠正”。

被动语态描述材料经历：is dug / are added / are dried；无需凭空添加工人或工厂地点。

答后精读

篇章结构

Overview起终点加主要加工阶段。

前段写原料准备与成形分支。

后段写热处理、冷却和配送。

词语与搭配

either by a wire cutter or by being placed in moulds：两种方式保持平行。

initially ... subsequently：区分两档窑温。

the resulting mixture：回指已经加入沙和水的黏土。

句子精读

The material is broken into smaller pieces before sand and water are added. → 两个被动结构保留明确先后。

They are then heated ... initially ... and subsequently ... → 同一heated谓语承接两个温度阶段。

同题官方考生样本 · Band 8.5 · 1C Script C

优先对照这份同题官方考生稿及考官评语；分数仅属于该原稿。本地参考段落仍为原创教学示范。

官方作答 · 第16页考官评语 · 第17页官方在线原件

先看原样本怎样概括关键阶段，再对照本地短段的分支、时长和温度；8.5仍有概述可改进处。

自行车使用率：年龄比较与百分点差未作答表格 · 原题拆段写作 · 参考段落与逐段讲解

官方样题 · IELTS Academic Writing — modified large print · PDF 第 4 页

The table below gives information about the percentage of the population by age group in one town who rode a bicycle in June 2011.

本次写作任务

写Overview及两个比较段（约150–180词），先比较儿童/青少年，再比较成人；指出最低组和60+回升。列出最大性别差距并用percentage points表达。

0 词

对照答案，回到证据

参考写法

下列段落为针对原题编写的参考写法，用于对照内容和表达；写作没有唯一标准答案。

Overall, cycling was most common among children under ten and least common in the 40–59 age group. Males had higher participation rates than females in every category, although the difference between the sexes was very small among the youngest children.

Among those aged 0–9, 51.3% of males and 50.3% of females rode a bicycle, a gap of just one percentage point. Participation was lower among 10–17-year-olds, at 42.2% for males and 24.6% for females. This group therefore had the largest gender difference, amounting to 17.6 percentage points, with the male figure considerably higher than the female one.

The proportions were smaller in both adult groups below sixty. For people aged 18–39, the rates were 17.1% and 9.7% respectively, falling to 12.3% and 8.0% among 40–59-year-olds. However, the figures rose again in the oldest category: 18.5% of men and 13.2% of women aged sixty or above cycled. Thus, participation did not simply decrease continuously across the age groups.

这是June 2011单月横截面：年龄组之间差异不证明同一批人随时间减少骑行。

10–17岁差距42.2−24.6=17.6个百分点；0–9岁差距1.0个百分点。

两性最低都是40–59岁，60+均回升；不能写年龄越大比例总是越低。

答后精读

篇章结构

Overview同时覆盖年龄高低与性别关系。

前段突出高参与儿童及最大差距青少年。

后段写成人低谷与60+例外。

词语与搭配

a gap of just one percentage point：不是one per cent decrease。

amounting to 17.6 percentage points：补充精确差值。

across the age groups：年龄间比较，避免错误时间趋势。

句子精读

For people aged 18–39, the rates were 17.1% and 9.7% respectively ... → 顺序沿用前段male/female。

However, the figures rose again in the oldest category ... → rose描述相邻年龄组数值变化，最后一句明确并非持续时间变化。

text: 练习 Task 1 · 折线图 Task 1 · 流程图 Task 1 · 平面图 Task 1 · 折线图 四行业就业 根据原图作答。 单位：million jobs。年份依次为 1960、1980、2000、2020。 Manufacturing：15、20、约17、13；Retail：6、10、15、16；Agriculture：6、3、3、2；Healthcare：2、5、11、16。 The graph shows employment in four sectors of the US economy from 1960 to 2020. 选出可由原图支持的一句。 A Manufacturing lost seven million jobs between 1960 and 2020. B Manufacturing ended two million jobs below its initial level, despite an earlier rise. C Healthcare employment increased sixteenfold over the period. D Agricultural employment fell during every interval shown. 作答 1 暂时不会 写 45–65 个英文词，比较 healthcare 和 retail 的绝对增量、相对增幅及最终水平。不要把岗位数写成就业占比。 作答 2 暂时不会 答案 1. B。 2. 示例：Healthcare employment rose from two million to sixteen million, adding fourteen million jobs and reaching eight times its initial level. Retail added ten million jobs, growing from six million to sixteen million, approximately 2.7 times its starting figure. Task 1 · 折线图 四行业就业

根据原图作答。

单位：million jobs。年份依次为 1960、1980、2000、2020。

Manufacturing：15、20、约17、13；Retail：6、10、15、16；Agriculture：6、3、3、2；Healthcare：2、5、11、16。

The graph shows employment in four sectors of the US economy from 1960 to 2020.

选出可由原图支持的一句。

  • A Manufacturing lost seven million jobs between 1960 and 2020.
  • B Manufacturing ended two million jobs below its initial level, despite an earlier rise.
  • C Healthcare employment increased sixteenfold over the period.
  • D Agricultural employment fell during every interval shown.

写 45–65 个英文词，比较 healthcare 和 retail 的绝对增量、相对增幅及最终水平。不要把岗位数写成就业占比。

答案

1. B。
2. 示例：Healthcare employment rose from two million to sixteen million, adding fourteen million jobs and reaching eight times its initial level. Retail added ten million jobs, growing from six million to sixteen million, approximately 2.7 times its starting figure. The two sectors therefore finished at the same level, despite markedly different growth rates.

再练一次

仍用这张图，写两句 overview，不列出逐年数字；必须同时呈现制造业的主导地位变化和农业的整体走势。

答案

示例：Manufacturing was initially the largest employer, but both retail and healthcare had overtaken it by the end of the period. Agriculture declined overall and remained the smallest sector in 2020.

Task 1 · 流程图 砖块制造

描述图中实际显示的顺序。

按图中箭头作答。图示数值：干燥 24–48 小时；中温窑 200–980°C；高温窑 870–1300°C；冷却 48–72 小时。

The diagram presents the manufacture of bricks for construction.

把下句改写为 35–50 个英文词，保留真实流程，写到干燥结束：After being mixed with sand and water, the clay is cut with a wire cutter and then pressed into moulds before being heated at 200–980°C in the drying oven.

只根据图示，哪一句成立？

  • A Every brick passes through both shaping methods.
  • B The complete manufacturing process takes no more than five days.
  • C Drying and cooling together account for between 72 and 120 hours, excluding all other stages.
  • D The minimum temperature in the second kiln stage exceeds the maximum in the first.
答案

1. 示例：After sand and water have been added, the clay mixture is shaped into bricks either with a wire cutter or in moulds. The newly formed bricks are then placed in a drying oven for between 24 and 48 hours.
2. C。

再练一次

用两句英文描述干燥之后、包装之前的流程。写出两组温度和冷却时间，不编写图中未给出的加热时长。

答案

The dried bricks pass through a kiln at a moderate temperature of 200–980°C and then a high-temperature stage of 870–1300°C. They are subsequently cooled in a chamber for 48–72 hours.

Task 1 · 平面图 学院咖啡厅改造

根据两张平面图作答。

The plans show a college café before its redesign and at present.

写 55–75 个英文词，描述两间原 staff dining rooms 的去向，并对比厨房、厕所和中央座位区。

修改这段文字中所有与图不符或缺少依据的内容，保留能由图支持的变化：The kitchen was moved to the south, while all the indoor tables were removed. A coffee bar replaced the kitchen. The old serving area now offers only hot meals, and the café provides outdoor seating beside a barbecue.

答案

1. 示例：The two former staff dining rooms have been converted into two separate food and drink outlets: takeaway food occupies the room on the left, while a coffee bar has replaced the room on the right. In contrast, the kitchen and toilets remain in their original locations, and the central area is still used for tables and chairs.
2. 示例：The kitchen remains in place, and the central indoor seating area has been retained. A coffee bar has replaced the right-hand staff dining room. The former serving area is now labelled 'Hot meals', while outdoor seating and a barbecue have been added.

再练一次

写两句 overview：一句概括食品供应设施的变化，一句对比保留的室内功能与新增的室外空间。不要猜测客流、营业时间或容纳人数。

答案

The café now has a wider range of dedicated food and drink outlets. The kitchen, toilets and central indoor seating area have been retained, while outdoor seating and a barbecue have been added.

text: IELTS / MY STUDY 写作 · Task 2练习 选择一个题组，先作答，再核对答案。 议论文 · 段落练习 用真实题目练习多段写作。先审题并写出自己的段落，再看针对原题的参考写法和修改依据。 共 12 组，来自 12 道不同原题；同源练习已标注。 查找 进度 全部 未作答 已作答 继续未做的一组 全部 同意程度 · 4 讨论双方 · 1 利弊权衡 · 2 双问 · 1 观点选择 · 1 原因与措施 · 3 没有符合条件的练习，试试更换关键词或进度。 高层住宅是否是城市住房的最佳方案 未作答 同意程度 · 原题拆段写作 · 参考段落与逐段讲解 真题 · Cambridge IELTS 21 Academic · PDF 第 31 页 写作前置 · 文中表达 下面的表达来自阅读材料，例句按本题语境编写。选择确实需要的表达即可。 Dar es Salaam · 城市扩张与交通方案 on the periphery 在城市外围 用于讨论住房位置与服务距离，需要说明外围扩张带来的具体条件，不能据此断定所有郊区住房都不好。 本题例句 · 编写示范 Building more homes on the periphery may lengthen journeys to work if public transport does not expand at the same time. 高层住宅题涉及如何在大城市提供足够住房；这一表达帮助比较外围扩张与紧凑建设的出行影响。 回到这份材料的精读 Dar es Salaam · 公交设计与实际故障 within a short walk of 距……很近，步行即可到达 说明住房与公交网络的空间联系；是否足够近应由实际布局支持。 本题例句 · 编写示范 Apartment blocks within a short walk of frequent public transport can provide more homes without making every resident dependent on a car. 直接用于比较高层住宅的条件：密度优势需要交通可达性支持。 回到这份材料的精读 The best way to provide enough homes in large cities is to build tall apartment blocks. To what extent do you agree or disagree with this statement? 本次写作任务 只写两段主体，约170–210词：先解释高层住宅怎样增加住房，再论证best way的适用边界。明确你赞成到什么程度；不把题目弱化为“高层住宅有没有好处”。 我的段落 0 词 保留作答，打开答案与精读 对照答案，回到证据 参考写法 下列段落为针对原题编写的参考写法，用于对照内容和表达；写作没有唯一标准答案。 Tall apartment blocks can make an important contribution where urban land is scarce. By placing many homes on the same site, a city can accommodate more residents without continually expanding into surrounding farmland. A development near an existing railway station may also allow more households to reach jobs without long car journeys. These benefits support the use of high-rise housing in well-connected districts. They are especially relevant when the alternative is low-density construction that provides relatively few homes on valuable central land. However, building upwards is not automatically the best response to every housing shortage. If the new flats are unaffordable, an increase in the total housing supply may do little for families who need reasonably priced accommodation. A large tower can also add pressure to schools, water systems and public transport if these services are not expanded. I would therefore favour tall buildings as one part of a wider strategy that also renovates empty properties and provides affordable homes. Their value depends on location, price and supporting infrastructure, rather than height alone. 题眼是best way，不只是a useful way。第二段用可负担性与配套条件检验“最佳”的范围。 第一段链条：同一地块更多住房→少向农地扩张；交通站点例子用may，不伪装统计研究。 两段最后形成“有条件赞成”：认可高层的贡献，同时不支持它作为所有城市的唯一最佳办法。 答后精读 篇章结构 优势机制—条件化例子—回扣城市土地约束。 限制条件—影响—明确程度立场。 词语与搭配 where urban land is scarce：限定论据适用地点。 do little for families who ...：解释新增供给为何不必然解决可负担问题。 one part of a wider strategy：表达有条件赞成。 句子精读 If the new flats are unaffordable, an increase ... may do little ... → 条件句直接检验题目的“provide enough homes”。 Their value depends on ... rather than height alone. → Their指tall buildings，结尾仍围绕建筑方案。 我的修订／证据笔记 线上娱乐与剧院影院的经济文化价值 未作答 讨论双方 · 原题拆段写作 · 参考段落与逐段讲解 真题 · Cambridge IELTS 21 Academic · PDF 第 53 页 写作前置 · 文中表达 下面的表达来自阅读材料，例句按本题语境编写。选择确实需要的表达即可。 The Davies Sisters｜印象派转向与战时收藏 a vibrant artists' community 一个充满活力的艺术家社群 适合与support、sustain、help build搭配，讨论实体文化空间如何为创作者提供交流和演出机会。这里借用表达描述一种可能作用，不把文中救助艺术家的历史直接当成剧院效果的证据。 本题例句 · 编写示范 Local theatres can help sustain a vibrant artists' community by giving performers opportunities to work together and reach an audience. 题目要求讨论剧院和影院的经济、文化价值；此表达适合展开剧院支持当地艺术生产和创作者交流的文化作用。 回到这份材料的精读 The Davies Sisters｜收藏停止与文化遗产 a lasting and meaningful cultural legacy 持久且有意义的文化遗产 可用于讨论文化活动对未来的贡献，但要写清通过什么机制传承，例如保留地方戏剧、作品或表演传统，不能只用抽象赞美代替解释。 本题例句 · 编写示范 Theatres that preserve local plays and performance traditions can leave a lasting and meaningful cultural legacy for future generations. 直接服务于实体剧院的文化价值：说明现场演出空间如何承载和传递传统，而不只比较观看的便利程度。 回到这份材料的精读 Miles Davis：困境、跨界与创造力 draw wider audiences 吸引范围更广的观众 可具体说明线上娱乐的可达性；观众范围扩大不等于线下场所失去全部文化价值。 本题例句 · 编写示范 Online screenings can draw wider audiences than a small theatre can accommodate, especially when viewers live far from major cities. 自编例句，直接回应线上娱乐的覆盖范围优势；can和especially保留条件，也为讨论剧院独有的现场体验留下空间。 回到这份材料的精读 Artificial Intelligence｜公众想象与解决一切的误区 no shortage of 大量；不缺 可以承认数字内容数量充足，再讨论数量之外的体验差异。 本题例句 · 编写示范 There is no shortage of films online, but access to a large catalogue does not reproduce the shared experience of a cinema. 自编例句，直接回应线上娱乐与影院价值：先承认线上内容丰富，再解释共同观看体验这一文化维度。 回到这份材料的精读 Some people say that in the digital age, theatres and cinemas are no longer important as people can watch all the entertainment they want online. Others argue that theatres and cinemas are still important both economically and culturally. Discuss both these views and give your own opinion. 本次写作任务 写两段主体，约180–220词：第一段把“线上足够”的理由讲完整，第二段解释剧院影院的经济和文化价值，并明确你的判断。不能只写我喜欢看电影。 我的段落 0 词 保留作答，打开答案与精读 对照答案，回到证据 参考写法 下列段落为针对原题编写的参考写法，用于对照内容和表达；写作没有唯一标准答案。 Those who question the importance of theatres and cinemas can point to the convenience of online entertainment. Viewers can choose what to watch and when to watch it, without paying for transport or arranging an evening around a fixed screening time. Online access may be particularly valuable to people living far from major cultural venues or caring for children at home. For these audiences, a subscription can offer a practical alternative to frequent visits. This makes the claim that physical venues are less necessary understandable, especially when the main aim is simply to see a film. Nevertheless, I believe these venues retain functions that a personal screen cannot fully reproduce. Economically, a performance supports performers, technicians and other staff, while audiences may also spend money in nearby businesses. Culturally, theatres can stage local stories and create a shared encounter between performers and spectators. Even in a cinema, an audience experiences a film together rather than as separate individuals at home. Online services can therefore widen access without removing the value of physical venues. The two forms can coexist, serving different circumstances and offering different kinds of participation. 第一段真正解释第一方观点：选择时间、出行成本、照顾孩子与地域可达性；没有直接贴标签后马上反驳。 第二段分别回应economically与culturally：岗位/周边消费与本地故事/共同体验。 立场是仍有价值、可共存；不是讨论互联网是否总体有害。 答后精读 篇章结构 解释线上取代说的合理条件与实际受益者。 转折后经济、文化两条机制，最后给出共存判断。 词语与搭配 a practical alternative to：适合替代某项活动，不等于完全替代所有功能。 retain functions that ... cannot fully reproduce：区分可替代与不可完全复制部分。 can coexist：立场收束而非非黑即白。 句子精读 Online access may be particularly valuable to people living ... or caring ... → living与caring平行修饰people。 The two forms can coexist, serving ... and offering ... → 两个分词补充共存的理由。 我的修订／证据笔记 本科海外学习或实习：收益能否超过代价 未作答 利弊权衡 · 原题拆段写作 · 参考段落与逐段讲解 真题 · Cambridge IELTS 21 Academic · PDF 第 74 页 写作前置 · 文中表达 下面的表达来自阅读材料，例句按本题语境编写。选择确实需要的表达即可。 Miles Davis：独特音色、双重教育与音乐遗产 a solid grounding in music theory 扎实的乐理基础 可说明专业理论如何支持实践；不把理论学习与工作实习写成只能二选一。 本题例句 · 编写示范 Music students with a solid grounding in music theory may learn to apply it during a placement in a recording studio. 自编例句，适用于本科课程是否应包括实习：音乐专业作为具体例子，说明已有理论知识怎样在工作环境中应用；不代表所有专业都需要录音棚实习。 回到这份材料的精读 All university undergraduate courses should include a period of time spent studying abroad or doing a work placement. Do you think the advantages of this would outweigh the disadvantages? 本次写作任务 写两段主体，约170–210词：一段承认费用和安排的代价，另一段讨论学习/就业收益，并按“能否控制、持续多久、影响多大”作权衡。注意abroad OR work placement，不要强制把两者都做。 我的段落 0 词 保留作答，打开答案与精读 对照答案，回到证据 参考写法 下列段落为针对原题编写的参考写法，用于对照内容和表达；写作没有唯一标准答案。 A compulsory period away from normal university classes can create real difficulties. Studying abroad may involve travel and accommodation costs, while even a local work placement can reduce the time available for paid employment. Students with caring responsibilities may find these demands particularly difficult. Universities also need enough suitable placements; an experience consisting only of routine administrative work would offer limited educational value. These drawbacks matter because the proposal applies to all undergraduate courses, including students and subjects for which arranging an appropriate experience may be challenging. Even so, I consider the potential advantages greater if institutions offer flexible, well-supported options. A relevant placement allows students to apply classroom ideas to actual workplace problems and obtain feedback from experienced colleagues. Overseas study can expose them to different academic approaches and require greater independence. These gains may continue to influence later study and employment, whereas some financial and practical barriers can be reduced through funding and local placement alternatives. To what extent do you agree or disagree with this opinion? 本次写作任务 写两段主体，约170–210词：解释有限预算可能培养什么能力，再指出财富不自动决定教养方式。比较双方，不把贫穷浪漫化为必然优势。 我的段落 0 词 保留作答，打开答案与精读 对照答案，回到证据 参考写法 下列段落为针对原题编写的参考写法，用于对照内容和表达；写作没有唯一标准答案。 Children in families with limited money may gain useful experience of making choices under constraints. If a household cannot afford every desired purchase, a child may have to save gradually, distinguish needs from wants and accept that one decision rules out another. Shared responsibilities can also encourage practical independence. These experiences resemble some of the budgeting and prioritising required in adult life. They provide a plausible reason why growing up without abundant resources could help a person cope with certain financial problems later on. However, I do not think family wealth alone determines how well someone is prepared. Persistent financial insecurity can create stress and restrict access to education or supportive activities, leaving children with fewer resources for future challenges. Conversely, wealthy parents can require their children to manage an allowance, contribute to household tasks and take responsibility for mistakes. Hotels, restaurants and transport operators need staff, and smaller enterprises can earn income from guiding, food or crafts. This can be especially valuable in places with few alternative sources of employment. Visitor interest may also give a community an incentive to maintain historic buildings and cultural activities. These benefits are strongest when local residents own businesses or obtain secure jobs, rather than when most revenue leaves the destination through external companies. 回到这份材料的精读 Scientific research should be carried out and controlled by governments, rather than by private companies. To what extent do you agree or disagree? 本次写作任务 写两个主体段，约170–210词。区分carried out与controlled：政府监督不必等于政府独占全部执行；针对题中的排他性rather than表态。 我的段落 0 词 保留作答，打开答案与精读 对照答案，回到证据 参考写法 下列段落为针对原题编写的参考写法，用于对照内容和表达；写作没有唯一标准答案。 Government involvement in research is essential where the public benefit is large but the prospect of commercial profit is uncertain. Leaving every decision to firms seeking a financial return could mean that important questions receive too little attention. However, these arguments do not justify excluding private companies from carrying out research. A firm developing a new material or production method may combine specialist knowledge with the ability to turn a discovery into a usable product. If only government bodies conducted research, potentially useful lines of investigation could be lost. Families can reasonably contribute when they have sufficient resources, but the contribution should depend on their means. A degree can provide substantial theoretical knowledge without giving students enough experience of applying it in a workplace. Employers may consequently hesitate to recruit applicants who need extensive practical training. A second difficulty arises when many students enter the same popular fields while local vacancies are concentrated elsewhere. In that situation, even capable candidates can compete for a limited number of positions, and the possession of a qualification alone does not create demand for their skills. Universities and employers should address the first problem through relevant placements and jointly designed practical projects. These would allow students to demonstrate their abilities and help firms assess potential recruits before offering permanent work. To reduce the second mismatch, students need clearer information about employment patterns and opportunities beyond the most familiar occupations. Careers services could support applications across related industries, while flexible retraining programmes could help graduates acquire additional skills. These measures cannot guarantee a job for every individual, but they respond directly to the gaps in experience and information rather than simply encouraging everyone to obtain another degree. Large vessels and efficient equipment allow operators to remove substantial quantities of fish, while each business may fear losing income if competitors continue fishing. The lack of activity opportunities also needs a direct response. Safe routes to school, accessible play areas and regular opportunities for movement during the school day can reduce barriers to being active. Parents, schools and local authorities each influence part of this environment, so coordinated changes are more likely to be useful than an isolated awareness campaign that leaves the underlying conditions unchanged. 原因1食品获取/营销环境→学校均衡供餐和实用信息；原因2活动机会不足→安全路线、场地、在校活动。 不用“kids are lazy”作为单一原因；解释环境如何影响日常选择，避免道德评判。 参考段落是任务论证示范，未用虚构数字、未经核验研究或诊疗建议增加权威感。 答后精读 篇章结构 饮食与活动环境两个原因，最后交代相互强化。 按同样次序匹配措施，并解释为何宣传单独不够。 词语与搭配 contributing factor：因素之一，避免假装唯一原因。 reduce barriers to being active：措施如何起效。 underlying conditions：回指便利食品与活动机会环境。 句子精读 These circumstances can reinforce one another ... → 指代上文两类环境而非增加新原因。 ... rather than rely only on telling children ... → 论证措施应改变条件，不只发口号。 我的修订／证据笔记 练习 Task 2 · 教育 Task 2 · 旅游 Task 2 · 城市住房 Task 2 · 教育 小学课堂中的学习与游戏 直接回应下面的完整题干。 待改写的立场句（自编）：I agree that play is useful because children enjoy it. Some people argue that primary schools focus too much on formal learning. To what extent do you agree with this opinion? How important do you think it is for children to play as well as learn in the primary school classroom? 把上面的立场句改写为 35–50 个英文词，同时回答两个问题。立场须允许一部分正式教学保留。 作答 1 暂时不会 写 80–110 个英文词，论证课堂游戏的一项学习价值，并用一个具体课堂活动说明。结尾说明这个活动为什么仍需要教师设计或引导。 作答 2 暂时不会 答案 1. 示例：I partly agree that primary schools devote too much time to formal instruction. Although direct teaching remains necessary, well-designed classroom play is important because it allows children to apply knowledge and practise cooperation in a meaningful setting. 2. 示例：Classroom play can make an abstract skill easier to use. For example, a teacher could organise a small shop in which pupils take turns buying items with pretend money. Children would have to add prices, calculate change and explain their choices to classmates. This activity gives a practical purpose to calculations that might otherwise remain a page of exercises. However, simply providing toys would not ensure that pupils learnt the intended skill. The teacher would still need to choose suitable prices, observe mistakes and help pupils understand how to correct them. 再练一次 仍回答原题，写 40–55 个英文词的结论。明确区分“正式教学过多”和“正式教学完全无用”，不要新增一个此前未论证的社会问题。 作答 暂时不会 答案 示例：Primary education should therefore place less emphasis on prolonged formal instruction, while preserving direct teaching where it is useful. Structured play deserves a regular place in the classroom because it helps children apply what they learn, but its educational value depends on thoughtful planning and guidance. 选材来源 · Cambridge IELTS 21 Academic · Test 4 · Task 2 Task 2 · 旅游 旅游收益与居民成本 在给定情境下作答，不把假设写成真实统计。 本练习的假设情境：旅游给当地商店带来收入，但旺季过后部分岗位消失；短租扩张减少了居民可租住房。地方政府可以对短租登记并征收用于公共交通的游客税。 International tourism has brought enormous benefit to many places. At the same time, there is concern about its impact on local inhabitants and the environment. Do the disadvantages of international tourism outweigh the advantages? 写 40–55 个英文词的立场段。不能只写“有好处也有坏处”；比较时须涉及受益者、受损者或影响持续时间。 作答 1 暂时不会 写 80–110 个英文词，比较商店收入与居民住房成本。结尾直接回答哪一方更重要，以及这个判断依赖什么条件。 作答 2 暂时不会 答案 1. 示例：In the situation described, the disadvantages outweigh the advantages if tourism income mainly reaches businesses while residents face lasting housing pressure. Temporary increases in trade cannot by themselves justify a continuing loss of affordable homes. Effective regulation could, however, change that balance. 2. 示例：Tourism may increase sales in local shops, but this benefit does not necessarily reach residents who must pay higher rents. The jobs created may also disappear after the main holiday season, whereas the conversion of homes into short-term accommodation can affect housing throughout the year. In this case, I would give greater weight to the lasting pressure on residents than to a temporary rise in commercial income. The balance could become more favourable if registration limits the loss of residential housing and visitor taxes finance services used by local people. 再练一次 把情境改为：短租得到有效控制，游客税确实改善了居民交通。用 35–50 个英文词说明原结论如何调整；不得声称旅游已经没有环境成本。 作答 暂时不会 答案 示例：With effective controls on short-term rentals and visible improvements in local transport, the economic benefits would be more likely to outweigh the disadvantages. However, that judgement would still depend on whether visitor activity placed manageable pressure on the environment. 选材来源 · IELTS Academic Writing Sample Tasks (2023) · Task 2B · 在线来源 Task 2 · 城市住房 高层住宅是否是最佳方案 围绕原题中的“best way”作答。 待改写句（自编）：Tall buildings contain more homes, so they are the best solution everywhere and will make housing affordable. The best way to provide enough homes in large cities is to build tall apartment blocks. To what extent do you agree or disagree with this statement? 将上面的句子改写为 35–50 个英文词。保留高层住宅的一项优势，但不给出题干未能支持的必然结果。 作答 1 暂时不会 写 80–110 个英文词：在土地紧张的城市里，将高层建设与“改造现有空置建筑”比较。选择一个判断标准，形成有条件的明确立场。 作答 2 暂时不会 答案 1. 示例：Tall apartment blocks can provide many homes on a limited area of land, making them useful in densely populated cities. However, additional supply does not automatically make housing affordable, and high-rise construction may not be the best option in every neighbourhood. 2. 示例：Where suitable vacant buildings already exist, converting them into homes may provide accommodation sooner than constructing new towers. On a short-term delivery criterion, conversion could therefore be the better option, provided the buildings are safe and reasonably inexpensive to adapt. However, the supply of suitable vacant property is limited, and conversion cannot be assumed to meet all future demand. I would support high-rise development where land is scarce and existing buildings cannot supply enough homes, rather than treating it as the best response to every housing shortage. 再练一次 写 35–50 个英文词的结论。明确同意程度，并保留“新增住房数量”和“住房可负担性”的区别。 作答 暂时不会 答案 示例：I therefore agree that high-rise construction can be an important response to urban housing shortages, but not that it is always the best one. Cities should assess alternative sources of supply, while using separate measures to ensure that additional homes are affordable. 选材来源 · Cambridge IELTS 21 Academic · Test 1 · Task 2 家庭与儿童：财富是否决定成年应对能力 家庭与儿童：财富是否决定成年应对能力 完整原题 Children who are brought up in families that do not have large amounts of money are better prepared to deal with the problems of adult life than children brought up by wealthy parents. To what extent do you agree or disagree with this opinion? Give reasons for your answer and include any relevant examples from your own knowledge or experience. Write at least 250 words. 导读 题目比较两类家庭中的孩子应对成年问题的准备程度。贫穷与富裕是条件；独立性、预算取舍、指导和机会才是可解释的机制。下面是本地编写的两段主体参考，不是完整作文或官方高分稿。可对照同一官方 PDF 第 21 页的 Script C，并读第 22 页的 Band 8.5 考官评语，比较立场、理由和概括范围；该分数仅属于官方考生稿。 参考主体段 Children in families with limited money may gain useful experience of making choices under constraints. If a household cannot afford every desired purchase, a child may have to save gradually, distinguish needs from wants and accept that one decision rules out another. Shared responsibilities can also encourage practical independence. These experiences resemble some of the budgeting and prioritising required in adult life. They provide a plausible reason why growing up without abundant resources could help a person cope with certain financial problems later on. However, I do not think family wealth alone determines how well someone is prepared. Persistent financial insecurity can create stress and restrict access to education or supportive activities, leaving children with fewer resources for future challenges. Conversely, wealthy parents can require their children to manage an allowance, contribute to household tasks and take responsibility for mistakes. Such practices may develop the same judgment and resilience without serious deprivation. I therefore reject the general comparison in the question: preparation depends more on the responsibilities, guidance and opportunities children receive than on whether their parents have a large income. 逐段解释 没有把may写成all poor children：有限预算可能培养技能，但严重匮乏也会限制机会。 对比对象始终是两类家庭中的孩子及成年应对能力，不转成贫富差距政策文章。 第二段以同样责任训练可存在于富裕家庭反驳“财富决定论”，给出明确不同意。 练习：先找出第一段的条件词may、could，再找第二段的反例。参考答案：有限预算可能培养选择能力，但压力和机会不足会削弱准备；富裕家庭也能通过责任与家务培养判断。因此无法只凭收入推出更充分的准备。 完整原件： IELTS Academic Writing Sample Tasks (2023) · Task 2A IELTS Academic Writing Sample Tasks (2023) · Task 2A 练原题：家庭财富与成年问题应对：避免绝对化 我的原题练习记录 按上方真实题目留下自己的回答或录音简记；参考内容用于对照，不必复述示范中的经历。 我的理解／想记住的表达（可留空） 已想过，查看理解提示 理解题可默想，不要求提交。 核对并修订 回到上方原题与具体示范，核对是否回应问题、证据是否准确，再改写自己的回答。 补充理解／新学到的表达 可选：记录或再练一次 我的例子／下次回顾记录 可选：记录或再练一次 这次最需要补什么？ 请选择 内容或语境没理解 词义或声音没认出 词汇选择／搭配不稳 证据、逻辑或展开不足 语法或句子组织问题 暂时独立完成，隔天再检验 同题官方考生样本 · Band 8.5 · 2A Script C 优先对照这份同题官方考生稿及考官评语；分数仅属于该原稿。本地参考段落仍为原创教学示范。 官方作答 · 第21页 考官评语 · 第22页 官方在线原件 标出立场与支持关系，再与自己的主体段比较；注意高分考评也指出局部泛化。 写作 · 海洋资源：执行捕捞上限 假设一个渔场已有捕捞上限，但部分渔船隐瞒渔获。用 60–80 个英文词写一项与这个问题直接对应的措施，说明执行方式与预期作用。不要写成全面禁止所有捕鱼。 作答 2 暂时不会 完成后核对写作示例 Authorities could require boats to record their catches and compare these records with inspections at landing sites. Targeted checks would make it harder to hide catches, while proportionate penalties could discourage repeated violations. This would address the gap between the legal limit and the amount actually taken from the sea. Monitoring would still be needed to establish whether the policy reduced fishing pressure and helped the stock recover. 再练一次 假设今年的捕捞速度已经降至允许范围，但鱼群总量仍低于恢复目标。用两句英文描述现状，并提出下一步行动；不宣称政策已经完全成功或完全失败。 作答 暂时不会 答案 The fishing rate is now within the permitted range, but the stock has not yet reached its recovery target. Managers should continue monitoring the population and adjust the recovery measures if the evidence indicates that further action is needed. 共用材料： 捕捞速度与鱼群总量 → 成人读写困难 · Task 2 新内容 · 2026-09-21 难度系数 3/5 · 中等 难度依据 须同时解释成人读写困难带来的具体不利处境，并提出由政府实施的对应帮助；不能只写儿童教育。 题意约束 3/5；论点抽象度 3/5；组织负荷 3/5 1–5为同科材料的编辑评估，数值越大任务负荷越高；不是官方Band或你的掌握度。 九分学长下载的Task 2题目；具体考场与考试日期未核实。核对要点和题干语言说明由本项目编写；允许不同成立观点，不自动评雅思分数。 · 预计48分钟（含核对与材料回读） You should spend about 40 minutes on this task. Dar es Salaam · 公交设计与实际故障

within a short walk of

距……很近，步行即可到达

说明住房与公交网络的空间联系；是否足够近应由实际布局支持。

本题例句 · 编写示范

Apartment blocks within a short walk of frequent public transport can provide more homes without making every resident dependent on a car.

直接用于比较高层住宅的条件：密度优势需要交通可达性支持。

回到这份材料的精读

The best way to provide enough homes in large cities is to build tall apartment blocks. To what extent do you agree or disagree with this statement?

本次写作任务

只写两段主体，约170–210词：先解释高层住宅怎样增加住房，再论证best way的适用边界。明确你赞成到什么程度；不把题目弱化为“高层住宅有没有好处”。

对照答案，回到证据

参考写法

下列段落为针对原题编写的参考写法，用于对照内容和表达；写作没有唯一标准答案。

Tall apartment blocks can make an important contribution where urban land is scarce. By placing many homes on the same site, a city can accommodate more residents without continually expanding into surrounding farmland. A development near an existing railway station may also allow more households to reach jobs without long car journeys. These benefits support the use of high-rise housing in well-connected districts. They are especially relevant when the alternative is low-density construction that provides relatively few homes on valuable central land.

However, building upwards is not automatically the best response to every housing shortage. If the new flats are unaffordable, an increase in the total housing supply may do little for families who need reasonably priced accommodation. A large tower can also add pressure to schools, water systems and public transport if these services are not expanded. I would therefore favour tall buildings as one part of a wider strategy that also renovates empty properties and provides affordable homes. Their value depends on location, price and supporting infrastructure, rather than height alone.

题眼是best way，不只是a useful way。第二段用可负担性与配套条件检验“最佳”的范围。

第一段链条：同一地块更多住房→少向农地扩张；交通站点例子用may，不伪装统计研究。

两段最后形成“有条件赞成”：认可高层的贡献，同时不支持它作为所有城市的唯一最佳办法。

答后精读

篇章结构

优势机制—条件化例子—回扣城市土地约束。

限制条件—影响—明确程度立场。

词语与搭配

where urban land is scarce：限定论据适用地点。

do little for families who ...：解释新增供给为何不必然解决可负担问题。

one part of a wider strategy：表达有条件赞成。

句子精读

If the new flats are unaffordable, an increase ... may do little ... → 条件句直接检验题目的“provide enough homes”。

Their value depends on ... rather than height alone. → Their指tall buildings，结尾仍围绕建筑方案。

Some people say that in the digital age, theatres and cinemas are no longer important as people can watch all the entertainment they want online. Others argue that theatres and cinemas are still important both economically and culturally. Discuss both these views and give your own opinion.

本次写作任务

写两段主体，约180–220词：第一段把“线上足够”的理由讲完整，第二段解释剧院影院的经济和文化价值，并明确你的判断。不能只写我喜欢看电影。

参考写法

下列段落为针对原题编写的参考写法，用于对照内容和表达；写作没有唯一标准答案。

Those who question the importance of theatres and cinemas can point to the convenience of online entertainment. Viewers can choose what to watch and when to watch it, without paying for transport or arranging an evening around a fixed screening time. Online access may be particularly valuable to people living far from major cultural venues or caring for children at home. For these audiences, a subscription can offer a practical alternative to frequent visits. This makes the claim that physical venues are less necessary understandable, especially when the main aim is simply to see a film.

Nevertheless, I believe these venues retain functions that a personal screen cannot fully reproduce. Economically, a performance supports performers, technicians and other staff, while audiences may also spend money in nearby businesses. Culturally, theatres can stage local stories and create a shared encounter between performers and spectators. Even in a cinema, an audience experiences a film together rather than as separate individuals at home. Online services can therefore widen access without removing the value of physical venues. The two forms can coexist, serving different circumstances and offering different kinds of participation.

第一段真正解释第一方观点：选择时间、出行成本、照顾孩子与地域可达性；没有直接贴标签后马上反驳。

第二段分别回应economically与culturally：岗位/周边消费与本地故事/共同体验。

立场是仍有价值、可共存；不是讨论互联网是否总体有害。

答后精读

篇章结构

解释线上取代说的合理条件与实际受益者。

转折后经济、文化两条机制，最后给出共存判断。

词语与搭配

a practical alternative to：适合替代某项活动，不等于完全替代所有功能。

retain functions that ... cannot fully reproduce：区分可替代与不可完全复制部分。

can coexist：立场收束而非非黑即白。

句子精读

Online access may be particularly valuable to people living ... or caring ... → living与caring平行修饰people。

The two forms can coexist, serving ... and offering ... → 两个分词补充共存的理由。

All university undergraduate courses should include a period of time spent studying abroad or doing a work placement. Do you think the advantages of this would outweigh the disadvantages?

本次写作任务

写两段主体，约170–210词：一段承认费用和安排的代价，另一段讨论学习/就业收益，并按“能否控制、持续多久、影响多大”作权衡。注意abroad OR work placement，不要强制把两者都做。

参考写法

下列段落为针对原题编写的参考写法，用于对照内容和表达；写作没有唯一标准答案。

A compulsory period away from normal university classes can create real difficulties. Studying abroad may involve travel and accommodation costs, while even a local work placement can reduce the time available for paid employment. Students with caring responsibilities may find these demands particularly difficult. Universities also need enough suitable placements; an experience consisting only of routine administrative work would offer limited educational value. These drawbacks matter because the proposal applies to all undergraduate courses, including students and subjects for which arranging an appropriate experience may be challenging.

Even so, I consider the potential advantages greater if institutions offer flexible, well-supported options. A relevant placement allows students to apply classroom ideas to actual workplace problems and obtain feedback from experienced colleagues. Overseas study can expose them to different academic approaches and require greater independence. These gains may continue to influence later study and employment, whereas some financial and practical barriers can be reduced through funding and local placement alternatives. The stronger policy is therefore to provide a meaningful choice between suitable forms of experience, with clear learning goals, rather than require every student to travel abroad.

题目是abroad or placement，末句明确保留本地实习选项；不能误写所有学生必须出国。

outweigh要求比较：长期学习收益与可缓解的成本相对照，而不是两边各列三点后不判断。

承认all courses的实施难题，立场带条件但清楚支持收益更大。

答后精读

篇章结构

负担—更脆弱人群—低质量安排的风险。

收益机制—长期价值—降低成本的方法—权衡结论。

词语与搭配

the proposal applies to all ...：抓住题目范围词。

may continue to influence ... whereas ...：把持续性作为权衡依据。

with clear learning goals：限制支持对象，防止无条件夸大。

句子精读

These drawbacks matter because the proposal applies to all undergraduate courses ... → because不是重复缺点，而是解释“为什么重要”。

... rather than require every student to travel abroad → 排除的是误读后的强制出国，不是否认原题。

Some people argue that primary schools focus too much on formal learning. To what extent do you agree with this opinion? How important do you think it is for children to play as well as learn in the primary school classroom?

本次写作任务

写两个主体段，约180–220词：第一段回答是否“过分”重视formal learning，第二段回答课堂游戏有多重要及其教育机制。游戏不是课外体育的同义词。

参考写法

下列段落为针对原题编写的参考写法，用于对照内容和表达；写作没有唯一标准答案。

I agree that formal learning can receive too much attention when a primary timetable leaves little space for exploration. Direct instruction is necessary for teaching children basic reading and arithmetic, and structured practice helps them become accurate. However, long sequences of worksheets and tests can make pupils focus on producing the expected answer rather than understanding an idea. For example, a child may memorise a calculation procedure but struggle to explain why it works. The problem is therefore not formal teaching itself, but an imbalance that treats written performance as the only useful evidence of learning.

Play has an important complementary role inside the classroom. In a pretend shop, children can practise counting, explain prices and take turns serving one another. The activity joins mathematical language with social interaction, giving a purpose to skills that might otherwise appear abstract. Building a model together can similarly require planning, discussion and revision after something fails. Such activities still need thoughtful guidance from the teacher, so that enjoyment supports a clear learning aim. I would consequently regard purposeful play as a regular part of primary education, rather than a reward offered only after all the serious work is finished.

第一段明确同意的范围：当formal learning挤压exploration时过多，而非主张取消识字算术。

第二段给出课堂内的假想商店与合作模型，回应primary classroom，不跑题到放学后娱乐。

play as well as learn提示两者结合；不是“玩”和“学”完全对立。

答后精读

篇章结构

先回答程度，再解释不平衡如何损害理解。

另段回答重要性，以具体课堂活动展示机制。

词语与搭配

an imbalance that ...：把批评集中到比例失衡。

an important complementary role：补充作用，不是否定正式教学。

purposeful play：有学习目的的课堂游戏。

句子精读

The problem is therefore not formal teaching itself, but an imbalance ... → 保持部分同意立场一致。

... so that enjoyment supports a clear learning aim → 目的从句解释教师指导的作用。

Children who are brought up in families that do not have large amounts of money are better prepared to deal with the problems of adult life than children brought up by wealthy parents. To what extent do you agree or disagree with this opinion?

对照答案，回到证据

参考写法

下列段落为针对原题编写的参考写法，用于对照内容和表达；写作没有唯一标准答案。

Children in families with limited money may gain useful experience of making choices under constraints. If a household cannot afford every desired purchase, a child may have to save gradually, distinguish needs from wants and accept that one decision rules out another. Shared responsibilities can also encourage practical independence. These experiences resemble some of the budgeting and prioritising required in adult life. They provide a plausible reason why growing up without abundant resources could help a person cope with certain financial problems later on.

However, I do not think family wealth alone determines how well someone is prepared. Persistent financial insecurity can create stress and restrict access to education or supportive activities, leaving children with fewer resources for future challenges. Conversely, wealthy parents can require their children to manage an allowance, contribute to household tasks and take responsibility for mistakes. Such practices may develop the same judgment and resilience without serious deprivation. I therefore reject the general comparison in the question: preparation depends more on the responsibilities, guidance and opportunities children receive than on whether their parents have a large income.

没有把may写成all poor children：有限预算可能培养技能，但严重匮乏也会限制机会。

对比对象始终是两类家庭中的孩子及成年应对能力，不转成贫富差距政策文章。

第二段以同样责任训练可存在于富裕家庭反驳“财富决定论”，给出明确不同意。

答后精读

篇章结构

承认一方可能的培养机制。

反例与变量区分，回应原题总体比较。

词语与搭配

distinguish needs from wants：与预算管理直接相关。

family wealth alone determines：抓住单一变量推断的问题。

responsibilities, guidance and opportunities：结尾归纳前文机制。

句子精读

If a household cannot afford every desired purchase, ... → 假设场景，不声称调查证明。

Such practices may develop the same judgment ... → Such practices回指前一句三项养育安排。
